headline: イラン・中東情勢、FRBが市場の主な焦点
executive_summary: 重要度Aのテーマは3件です。市場データは未取得または限定的です。投資判断ではなく、公開情報の整理として確認してください。

sections.title: イラン・中東情勢
sections.summary: イラン・中東情勢では、France says sanctions relief for Iran impossible while Hormuz remains closed / What included in talks to end the Iran war and reopen Hormuz ?  / Oil Prices Rise Amid Strait of Hormuz Tensions and U . S .- Iran Ceasefire Uncertainty が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: FRB
sections.summary: FRBでは、Federal Reserve Board releases results from two surveys of senior financial officers at banks about their views on discount window operating days and their strategies and practices for managing reserve balances / Federal Reserve Board names Jerome H. Powell as chair pro tempore; Powell will serve as chair pro tempore until Kevin M. Warsh is sworn in as the new chair / Minutes of the Board's discount rate meeting on April 20 and 29, 2026 が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: 要人発言
sections.summary: 要人発言では、Bowman, When Regulation Reshapes Markets: The Migration of Corporate Lending / Cook, Perspectives on Tokenization and Implications for the Financial System / Barr, Measuring Financial Health が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: その他
sections.summary: その他では、Washington - Tahran hattında kritik saatler ! Dünya , İran  ın cevabına kilitlendi : Anlaşma yakın /   Если пожелает Аллах : Иран клянется не разрабатывать ядерное оружие / İran ile ABD arasında 60 günlük ateşkes bugün duyurulabilir : İşte anlaşma şartları が主な確認材料です。
